data.content_ref: inline:The protocol mandates deterministic replay from the last barrier to reconstitute the workspace before deciding whether evidence was completed, but this replay step is a destructive write operation on the workspace itself. If the crashed process had in fact completed the evidence but merely failed to write the terminal record, the replay overwrites that completed evidence, silently displacing it before the protocol ever evaluates completion. A protocol guaranteed never to silently displace evidence must not perform destructive reconstruction on a workspace whose contents are unknown; it must first preserve or non-destructively inspect the existing state.
